scope: One bounded shared-parameter calibration on complete tightened T1 and new Q2 records. Old loose Q2 and all previously fitted parameter vectors excluded from both objective and numerical initialization. Existing solver structure, numerical bounds and observation convention retained; no claim of methodological independence from earlier exploration.
initialization: One symmetric numerical seed declared before fitting. Order-of-magnitude numerical hypothesis, not independently identified physical parameters; not copied from a fitted parameter file. No multi-start search.
boundsMeaning: Numerical bounds preserve positive input gains, nonnegative friction/damping/spring and SPD mass. They are not measured physical parameter bounds.
objective: Equal record weight 0.5 times actual-duration weighted mean-position and full left-minus-right synchronization waveform squared prediction errors in mm, at all 8300 decoded endpoints per record, plus 1e-8 scaled-parameter regularization. No CA ranking, favorable segment selection, scalar task RMS matching or outcome-based record removal.
input: Original queued moving 1ms commands and actual dt; hold segments use their 40-step mean input approximation. No actuator filter, offset or observation map change.
simulation: One zero initial state per complete 20s record; no future measured state injection. Forced input replay, not closed-loop counterfactual validation.
dataLimitations: T1 full motion blob CRC valid; post-export tail 6.88s rather than protocol 10s.
Q2 has one previous-session prefix row excluded by reset identity, not its outcome.
Hold 40-step input waveform unavailable; mean input approximation retained.
evaluation: Report both whole records, before/after waveform errors and task tracking/synchronization RMS, including unfavorable results. Both records are calibration data. Independent numerical verification is not independent physical validation; no physical acceptance threshold is introduced after observing the fit.
